rows.vgi.doc_md:
# CVE Lookup & Offline CVSS Scoring for DuckDB

**Query CVE / vulnerability data and compute CVSS v3.1 severity scores directly in SQL.** The `cve` extension turns DuckDB into a defensive vulnerability-management workbench: resolve advisories, search vulnerability descriptions, map products to the vulnerabilities that affect them, and score CVSS vectors offline — all without leaving your query editor.

This worker is built for security engineers, vulnerability-management and patch teams, threat researchers, and data analysts who need to enrich, triage, and report on software vulnerabilities at SQL speed. The live lookups read from the National Vulnerability Database (NVD) 2.0 REST API, which republishes and enriches the public CVE records curated by the MITRE-led CVE Program. The scoring math is a faithful, dependency-free implementation of the CVSS v3.1 base-metric equation maintained by FIRST, so a vector string always maps to the same base score and qualitative severity band that the official calculator produces.

The extension is organized in two complementary halves. **Offline CVSS scoring** runs with no network access at all: it parses a CVSS:3.1 vector string into its numeric base score and buckets any numeric score into its qualitative band (NONE, LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, or CRITICAL), fully deterministic and safe for air-gapped or high-volume pipelines. **Live NVD 2.0 lookups** stream vulnerability records from the National Vulnerability Database and accept optional `base_url` and `api_key` arguments so you can target a mirror or raise NVD rate limits with a personal key.

Reach for this worker whenever you need to attach severity to raw CVSS vectors, look up the details of a known advisory, discover vulnerabilities by keyword or by affected product, or join vulnerability data against your own asset inventory. CVEs still under analysis surface a SQL `NULL` score rather than a misleading zero.

## Learn more

- CVSS specification and scoring (FIRST): [first.org/cvss](https://www.first.org/cvss/) — [CVSS v3.1 specification document](https://www.first.org/cvss/v3-1/specification-document) and the [official CVSS v3.1 calculator](https://www.first.org/cvss/calculator/3-1).
- CVE records and program (MITRE): [cve.org](https://www.cve.org) — source data in the [CVE List repository](https://github.com/CVEProject/cvelistV5).
- This worker's source: [github.com/Query-farm/vgi-cve](https://github.com/Query-farm/vgi-cve).
